core.headline: Brook Hall, near Frant: Edwardian country house in 4.5 acres
core.summary: Gated Edwardian country house with approx. 4.5 acres including a 3-acre paddock, heated outdoor pool, oak-framed triple cart lodge (2025) with one-bedroom annexe above, and views across the High Weald National Landscape
core.listing:
Brook Hall is a detached Edwardian country house standing in approx. 4.5 acres near Frant, East Sussex. The property is approached by a gated drive and includes a 3-acre paddock, a heated outdoor pool and an oak-framed triple cart lodge with a one-bedroom annexe above.

The house was built in 1908 with brick and tile-hung upper elevations under a clay-tiled roof. The principal reception rooms comprise a drawing room measuring 7.10m x 5.20m (23'4" x 17'1") and a dining room measuring 5.40m x 4.60m (17'9" x 15'1"). There are four reception rooms in total.

The kitchen/breakfast room measures 8.20m x 4.90m (26'11" x 16'1").

The house provides five bedrooms and four bathrooms. The principal bedroom measures 5.60m x 4.80m (18'4" x 15'9").

The gardens include a terrace and a heated outdoor pool served by an air source heat pump. The 3-acre paddock lies beyond. The oak-framed triple cart lodge was built in 2025 following planning permission granted the same year; the one-bedroom annexe sits above.

Frant station is approx. 2 miles (London Bridge approx. 1 hour). Royal Tunbridge Wells is approx. 4 miles.

Guide Price £2,100,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band H (Wealden District Council). EPC rating E. Construction: Standard – Brick with tile-hung upper elevations under a clay-tiled roof. Electricity: Mains. Water: Mains (not metered). Sewerage: Treatment plant. Heating: Oil-fired central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: Limited indoors; good outdoor coverage. Parking: Gated drive with parking for several cars; triple cart lodge. The property is within the High Weald National Landscape. A public footpath crosses the southern edge of the paddock. Planning permission was granted in 2025 for the cart lodge with annexe above (built). Council tax banding of the annexe has not been confirmed.
